_metadata.description: Device-emulation chrome around the preview iframe: viewport presets, zoom, rotate, reset; persists across sessions.

requirements.title: Viewport preset dropdown with mobile/tablet/desktop and named devices
requirements.description: Preset list includes at minimum: iPhone 14 (390x844), iPhone SE (375x667), iPad (768x1024), iPad Pro (1024x1366), Desktop 1280, Desktop 1440, Desktop 1920. Selecting a preset sets iframe width/height; mode label appears in the chrome.

validation.notes: UI store-state test verifies preset selection updates the emulator state machine; component test asserts dropdown lists all presets.

requirements.title: Continuous zoom 10–200% with a slider and discrete step buttons
requirements.description: Zoom values clamp to [0.1, 2.0]; applied as a CSS transform on the iframe wrapper, never as a viewport resize. A reset button returns zoom to 1.0.

validation.notes: Store-state test asserts clamp; component test asserts slider/zoom-out/zoom-in/reset interactions.

requirements.title: Rotate flips width/height; reset clears all emulator state
requirements.description: Rotate swaps width and height while preserving the active preset label. Reset returns to the default preset, zoom 1.0, no rotation.

requirements.title: Emulator state persists across sessions
requirements.description: Last selected preset, zoom, and rotation persist via `localStorage` under a namespaced key. Restoration tolerates schema drift (unknown preset → default).

validation.notes: Hook test mounts useDeviceEmulation, dispatches changes, asserts localStorage payload; second mount reads it.
